titulo: A real routine and Jarvis up and running
lead: An assistant you don't use is no good. In this lesson you turn one task from your week into a fixed request, use it five days in a row, and write down what to improve. Then you see the steps for keeping it running: on your computer, with automatic restart, and on a rented server, up 24 hours a day.
objetivo: use a fixed request for five days in a row and choose where the assistant will stay running, from your laptop to a 24-hour server.

aprende.t: Turn a task into a fixed request
The task list that leads to step 3

hero_alt: Morning in neutral light: a cup, an open calendar, and a phone with a short list of three items.

secoes.sub: Four steps, from testing to 24 hours. Click each one.

nos.detalhe: Where you finish lesson 4: green tests and a chat in the terminal with the test model. No internet and no key.
With the token and a real model, you chat from your phone. Limit: when you close your laptop, the assistant goes to sleep with it.
On the Mac, the plan uses launchd: the assistant starts when you turn on the computer and restarts on its own if it crashes. The logs go in a log folder for troubleshooting.

A rented server stays on day and night. The path is the same: log in through the terminal, clone, and ask the agent to build. The difference is the packaging: for a server, the build page points to Docker.

secoes.legenda: One at a time: Telegram, then automatic restart, then server. Move to each step only when the previous one is stable.

texto: Pick one of the three things it should do every week, from the lesson 2 design.
Choose one you would do anyway: that way the week of use actually happens.

exemplo.texto: Start the day with the three priorities.

passos.titulo: Turn it into a fixed request
texto: Write the request in AGENTS.md: when you send a short word, it does the task the same way.
Scheduling on its own (sending without you asking) is in the plan for the next phase; for now, you are the one who triggers it.

exemplo.texto: Every morning, when I send "dia", list my three priorities based on what I told you yesterday.

texto: Use it for five days in a row. Each day, one line: what worked and what was missing.
Wrong tone? SOUL. Forgot something? Memory. Did something it shouldn't have? AGENTS.

exemplo.texto: Day 3: listed 5 priorities instead of 3. Adjust AGENTS.

texto: Once a week, look at your notes and the log and change just one thing. Run the tests again.
There is no ready-made assistant: there is one that gets better with real use.

exemplo.texto: One change per week, tests green before and after.

secoes.sub: Copy them into your AGENTS.md and your meu-jarvis.md.

- When I send "fim": ask what I finished today and save it to memory.

abas.html:
You: dia

Jarvis:

  1. Finish the sales report (it's Monday).
  2. Reply to the client about the deadline.
  3. Prepare the agenda for Thursday's meeting.

All three come from what you told me yesterday and from memory.

• Week 1: the core running on your main channel.
  • Week 2: memory actually saving, plus one or two tools.
  • Week 3: always on (automatic restart or a server).
  • Week 4: first round of improvements based on the log and your notes.

perguntas.p: What makes a good standing request?
opcoes: "When I send 'dia', list my top three priorities based on what I told you yesterday."
"Faça o que achar melhor toda manhã."
perguntas.explica: It has a trigger (the word), a task, a limit (three), and a source (what you told it). You can check whether it did it right.

perguntas.p: You close your laptop and the assistant stops responding. What fixes it?
opcoes: A rented server (VPS) that stays on 24 hours a day, using the same build path.
perguntas.explica: On a laptop it sleeps along with you. On a server, it stays on day and night; the recommended packaging for a server is Docker.

perguntas.p: On day 3 it listed five priorities instead of three. Where do you fix it?
opcoes: In SOUL.md, by changing the personality.
In AGENTS.md, in the fixed-request rule (three at most).
perguntas.explica: It's a work rule, so it lives in AGENTS.md. One change, run the tests again, and check the next day.

itens.texto: Channel, loop with a brake, identity, brain, memory, tools, and vault. Once you understand the pieces, you choose better and switch without fear.
SOUL, AGENTS, USER, and MEMORY are text. Change the text, and you change the assistant.
Briefing + plan + request with tests. The test confirms it, not the promise.
One owner only, limits in the vault, one fixed request for a week, and one improvement at a time.
